title: 2.4 Protozoa
description: Single-celled eukaryotic protists, their movement, feeding, life stages and reproduction. Easy level, 20 questions.

questions.question: What is Protozoan?
options: A protozoan that lives independently in soil or water
A short hair-like structure that beats to move a cell
A protozoan that derives nutrients from a living host
A unicellular eukaryote that feeds on organic matter
questions.correctAnswer: A unicellular eukaryote that feeds on organic matter
